text:
maya: Nightly eval flagged a big regression on the ja↔ko code-switch prompt set. BLEU delta -7.2 vs baseline. Seen on int8 builds only. https://internal.evals/abcd

 dmitri: Which nightly? model/commit?

 maya: 2026-03-18 23:45 (nightly v1.4.0-int8). root ts 1719032100

 li-wei: Confirmed locally: int8 shows breakdown on short mixed-language prompts with punctuation. fp16/fp32 look fine.

 olga: sample prompt + output:

 ```
 prompt: "한국어로 질문: こんにちは、あなたの名前は？"
 expected: "저는 ... / 私の名前は..."
 actual: "Hello, my name is" (english fallback) OR repeated tokens like "名前 名前 名前"
 ```

 samir: sounds like detokenization mismatch when fullwidth/halfwidth punctuation mixes. We merged new ja merges last week (PR abc123) — could be related.

 nightly-eval-bot: Alert: Regression detected in `ja-ko-code-switch` suite. Delta -7.2 BLEU. Failing shards: 14/50. CID: reg-20260318-XY

 dmitri: Can someone run repro with `--tokenizer-multilingual=false` and compare? I'll bisect commits abc110..abc130.

 li-wei: repro command I used:

 ```
 python tools/repro.py --model rwd/v1.4.0-int8 --prompts data/ja_ko_cs_subset.json --tokenizer-config configs/tokenizer.json --out logs/ja_ko_int8_repro.log
 ```

 olga: also seeing high perplexity jumps and stray `▁` tokens in the token stream when punctuation is mixed (comma/、 plus ?/？).

 samir: I'll try reverting the tokenizer merge locally and run the same subset. if that reproduces we can hotfix and push a patched int8 build.

 maya: Plan: dmitri run bisect, samir try revert/hotfix, li-wei run expanded eval overnight on both int8 and fp16. I'll file a bug and add to triage board, tagging @oncall-ml.

 eval-bot: Created issue RWD-ML-4271: "ja/ko code-switch BLEU regression (int8)" assigned to eng-ml. Links: https://issues.internal/RWD-ML-4271

 dmitri: starting bisect now, will post intermediate failing commit.

 olga: dropping sample logs into the issue (tok dumps + outputs).

 maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
